subject: Coordinating short walkthrough — propose 2-3 time bands & decision owners

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + propose 2-3 short windows for the 30m walkthrough

Hi Elaine / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a short (30-minute) product intro and include the right stakeholders: 

- Recap: You want to see the inference routing + cost controls and confirm integration pattern for on-prem telemetry.
- Goal for the 30m: high-level product walkthrough, sample latency/cost dashboard, and next-step mutual action plan assignment.
- Required attendees (from our side): Product PM, an engineering SME (for integration questions), and a short ops/security intro if you want it.

Propose 3 windows next week (all times PT):
1) Tue 14 May — 10:00–10:30 PT (17:00–17:30 UTC)
2) Wed 15 May — 08:30–09:00 PT (15:30–16:00 UTC)
3) Thu 16 May — 11:00–11:30 PT (18:00–18:30 UTC)

If none of those work, send two preferred blocks and we’ll adapt. Also please confirm who from MerriTech should join (security/infra/PO) so we can include Priyom and Ben appropriately. I’ve attached a short pre-demo ops checklist and will drop an updated mutual action plan after we pick time.

Links: HubSpot HS:48017 (opportunity), quick calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/laura-merri-abc123

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.

—Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the recap. Good summary. We can do Wed 15 May 08:30–09:00 PT (the morning slot) — that works best for our PO and a couple of infra folks.

Please include our security lead Maya Singh (maya.singh@merritech.com) on the invite — she’ll have a couple quick questions on data residency and audit logs. Also: can the engineering SME be prepared to talk about typical token throughput and any prefix-caching recommendations for batch inference?

Cheers,

Ben / Priyom — can you both join the short walkthrough and be ready to cover:
- Ben: token throughput, typical latency numbers for a comparable workload (e.g., 1–2k tokens/session), and prefix/KV caching patterns.
- Priyom: rollout milestones we should capture in the MAP and a proposed 60-day success criteria list.

I’m attaching an updated MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN-v2.xlsx (lightweight) so Priyom and the MerriTech team can start assigning owners. If anyone needs a different time, flag here — otherwise I’ll send a calendar invite with the join link and the ops checklist attached.
